symptom: PC in VLAN 10 gets an IP address but cannot ping its default gateway.
topology_note: Access switch connects PC1 to SW1 Fa0/3; gateway should be SVI VLAN 10 at 192.168.10.1.
show_outputs: show ip interface brief: Vlan10 administratively down down. show vlan brief: VLAN 10 active with Fa0/3 assigned.
expected_fault: SVI VLAN 10 is administratively shut down.
fix_steps: Enter interface vlan 10; run no shutdown; verify with show ip interface brief and ping gateway.

symptom: PC in VLAN 20 can ping gateway but cannot reach server in VLAN 30.
topology_note: Router-on-a-stick link from SW1 to R1 should carry VLANs 20 and 30.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: Gi0/1 allowed vlans 1,20. show ip route: connected routes for VLAN 20 and VLAN 30 exist on R1.
expected_fault: VLAN 30 is not allowed on the trunk toward the router.
fix_steps: Add VLAN 30 to the trunk allowed list; verify trunk state and retest inter-VLAN ping.

symptom: Client receives 169.254 address instead of DHCP lease.
topology_note: DHCP service runs on R1 for VLAN 40 clients.
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool: network 192.168.50.0 /24 default-router 192.168.40.1. Client VLAN is 192.168.40.0 /24.
expected_fault: DHCP pool network does not match the client VLAN subnet.
fix_steps: Correct the DHCP pool network to 192.168.40.0 /24; clear bindings; renew client lease.

symptom: User can ping 8.8.8.8 but cannot browse by hostname.
topology_note: Campus DNS server should be 192.168.100.53.
show_outputs: nslookup intranet.local: DNS request timed out. ipconfig: DNS server 192.168.100.99.
expected_fault: Client has the wrong DNS server address.
fix_steps: Set DNS server to 192.168.100.53 and verify name resolution with nslookup.

symptom: Branch LAN can reach router but not headquarters subnet.
topology_note: Static routing is used between branch router BR1 and HQ router HQ1.
show_outputs: show ip route on BR1: Gateway of last resort is not set. No route to 10.10.0.0/16.
expected_fault: Branch router is missing a route to the headquarters network.
fix_steps: Add a static route to 10.10.0.0/16 via the WAN next hop; verify with traceroute.

symptom: Server can ping inside clients but inside clients cannot access the internet.
topology_note: R1 provides PAT for inside VLANs to ISP.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: empty. show run: interfaces lack ip nat inside and ip nat outside.
expected_fault: NAT inside/outside roles are missing on router interfaces.
fix_steps: Configure ip nat inside on LAN interface and ip nat outside on WAN interface; verify translations.

symptom: PC in VLAN 15 cannot obtain DHCP but static IP works.
topology_note: DHCP server is on another subnet and relay should be configured on SVI VLAN 15.
show_outputs: show run interface vlan 15: no ip helper-address present. DHCP server reachable from switch.
expected_fault: DHCP relay helper address is missing on VLAN 15 SVI.
fix_steps: Add ip helper-address pointing to the DHCP server; renew the client lease.

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi clients can access an internal payroll server.
topology_note: Guest SSID should map to isolated VLAN 90 with restricted access.
show_outputs: show access-lists GUEST-FILTER: no deny statement for 10.20.30.10. show wlan summary: Guest SSID mapped to VLAN 90.
expected_fault: Guest wireless ACL does not block the internal server.
fix_steps: Add explicit deny from guest VLAN to payroll server before general permits; verify from guest client.

symptom: Two PCs intermittently lose connectivity in VLAN 25.
topology_note: Both PCs were manually configured during lab setup.
show_outputs: show logging: %IP-4-DUPADDR duplicate address 192.168.25.18 on Vlan25. ARP table flaps between two MAC addresses.
expected_fault: Two hosts are using the same IP address.
fix_steps: Assign a unique IP or return one host to DHCP; clear ARP and test stability.

symptom: PC can ping local gateway but cannot ping remote subnet after ACL was added.
topology_note: ACL 110 is applied inbound on R1 Gi0/0.
show_outputs: show access-lists 110: deny ip 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 any matches 42; permit ip any any. show run interface Gi0/0: ip access-group 110 in.
expected_fault: ACL denies traffic from the local subnet before the permit statement.
fix_steps: Replace or reorder ACL entries to permit required traffic; confirm hit counts and retest.

symptom: VLAN 60 users cannot communicate with each other on the same switch.
topology_note: Ports Fa0/10 and Fa0/11 should be access ports in VLAN 60.
show_outputs: show vlan brief: VLAN 60 not found. Fa0/10 assigned to VLAN 1 and Fa0/11 assigned to VLAN 1.
expected_fault: VLAN 60 has not been created or assigned to access ports.
fix_steps: Create VLAN 60 and assign both access ports; verify MAC learning in VLAN 60.

symptom: Server in DMZ cannot return traffic to campus clients.
topology_note: DMZ router has connected route to server and default route to ISP only.
show_outputs: show ip route on DMZ-R: no route to 172.16.0.0/16. Ping from campus reaches DMZ interface but replies fail.
expected_fault: DMZ router lacks a return route to the campus network.
fix_steps: Add route to campus summary via the core router; verify bidirectional ping.

symptom: Printer has IP address but PCs in same VLAN cannot reach it.
topology_note: Printer was manually configured with IP 192.168.70.45.
show_outputs: Printer config: subnet mask 255.255.0.0. VLAN 70 uses 255.255.255.0. ARP entries look inconsistent.
expected_fault: Printer subnet mask is too broad for the VLAN.
fix_steps: Set printer mask to 255.255.255.0; renew neighbor entries and test printing.

symptom: New access point SSID is visible but clients cannot reach network resources.
topology_note: AP uplink connects to SW2 Gi0/5 and should be trunked.
show_outputs: show interfaces Gi0/5 switchport: operational mode static access; access vlan 1. WLAN users expected in VLAN 80.
expected_fault: AP uplink is configured as access instead of trunk.
fix_steps: Configure AP uplink as trunk and allow required WLAN VLANs; reconnect client.

symptom: PC in VLAN 100 can reach internet but not internal file server by IP.
topology_note: Security ACL is applied between user VLAN and server VLAN.
show_outputs: show access-lists USERS-TO-SERVERS: deny tcp 192.168.100.0 0.0.0.255 host 10.1.5.20 eq 445 matches deny.
expected_fault: ACL blocks SMB traffic to the file server.
fix_steps: Permit authorized SMB traffic above the deny rule; verify with server access test.

symptom: Remote office phones fail to register after subnet change.
topology_note: Voice VLAN changed from 192.168.150.0/24 to 192.168.151.0/24.
show_outputs: show ip dhcp pool VOICE: network 192.168.150.0 /24 default-router 192.168.150.1 option 150 10.10.10.10.
expected_fault: Voice DHCP pool still references the old subnet and gateway.
fix_steps: Update voice DHCP network and default router; clear old bindings; reboot one test phone.

symptom: Host can reach local subnets but not internet after NAT ACL edit.
topology_note: PAT uses ACL 1 to identify inside networks.
show_outputs: show run | include access-list 1: access-list 1 permit 192.168.99.0 0.0.0.255. Inside LAN is 192.168.10.0/24.
expected_fault: NAT ACL matches the wrong inside subnet.
fix_steps: Correct NAT ACL to permit the inside LAN; clear translations and test internet access.

symptom: Only VLAN 200 fails across the distribution trunk.
topology_note: Other VLANs pass correctly between SW1 and DSW1.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: Gi1/0/1 allowed vlans 10,20,30,100. VLAN 200 not allowed on trunk.
expected_fault: VLAN 200 is missing from the trunk allowed VLAN list.
fix_steps: Add VLAN 200 to the allowed VLAN list on both trunk ends; verify spanning-tree state.

symptom: A lab PC cannot ping anything outside its subnet.
topology_note: PC address is 192.168.12.50/24; gateway should be 192.168.12.1.
show_outputs: ipconfig: Default Gateway 192.168.21.1. Ping 192.168.12.1 succeeds only when manually targeted.
expected_fault: PC default gateway is set to the wrong subnet.
fix_steps: Change default gateway to 192.168.12.1; verify route table and remote ping.

symptom: Core switch cannot route between VLANs after new SVI was added.
topology_note: Multilayer switch should perform inter-VLAN routing.
show_outputs: show run: no ip routing. show ip route unavailable; show interfaces vlan shows SVIs up.
expected_fault: IP routing is disabled on the multilayer switch.
fix_steps: Enable ip routing; verify connected routes and inter-VLAN reachability.

symptom: Wireless guest clients receive corporate VLAN addresses.
topology_note: Controller maps SSID Guest to VLAN 10 instead of VLAN 90.
show_outputs: show wlan summary: Guest interface VLAN 10. Corporate users also use VLAN 10.
expected_fault: Guest SSID is mapped to the wrong VLAN.
fix_steps: Map Guest SSID to VLAN 90 and enforce guest ACL; renew guest client lease.

symptom: DNS server is reachable by IP but users get stale intranet address.
topology_note: Internal DNS zone was updated during server migration.
show_outputs: nslookup intranet.local: returns 10.1.1.20. New server IP is 10.1.1.30. Ping 10.1.1.30 succeeds.
expected_fault: DNS A record points to the old server address.
fix_steps: Update DNS A record to 10.1.1.30; clear DNS cache; retest by hostname.

symptom: Laptop on access port cannot join VLAN 35 network.
topology_note: Switchport was copied from a trunk configuration.
show_outputs: show interfaces Fa0/7 switchport: administrative mode trunk; access vlan 35; operational trunking encapsulation dot1q.
expected_fault: User-facing port is incorrectly configured as a trunk.
fix_steps: Set the port to access mode in VLAN 35; disable unused trunk negotiation.

symptom: Server replies fail after default gateway replacement.
topology_note: Server IP is 10.5.5.25/24; gateway should now be 10.5.5.1.
show_outputs: Server config: default gateway 10.5.5.254. Router 10.5.5.254 removed from topology.
expected_fault: Server default gateway points to a removed router.
fix_steps: Set server default gateway to 10.5.5.1; verify return path with traceroute.

symptom: OSPF neighbors form but remote LAN route is absent.
topology_note: R2 remote LAN interface is newly added.
show_outputs: show ip protocols: network 10.0.0.0 0.0.0.3 area 0 only. show ip route ospf lacks 192.168.220.0/24.
expected_fault: Routing process does not advertise the new LAN network.
fix_steps: Add the LAN network to OSPF or advertise connected route; verify route propagation.

symptom: Inside host reaches external IP but return traffic is dropped at edge firewall ACL.
topology_note: Edge router has ACL OUTSIDE-IN applied inbound from ISP.
show_outputs: show access-lists OUTSIDE-IN: deny ip any 192.168.10.0 0.0.0.255 matches deny. NAT translation exists for host.
expected_fault: Outside inbound ACL blocks return traffic to translated inside host.
fix_steps: Permit established or expected return traffic according to lab policy; retest session.

symptom: New VLAN 45 users can ping gateway but not DHCP server across router.
topology_note: DHCP relay should forward broadcasts to 10.10.40.5.
show_outputs: show run interface vlan 45: ip address 192.168.45.1 255.255.255.0; ip helper-address 10.10.40.50. DHCP server is 10.10.40.5.
expected_fault: DHCP helper address points to the wrong server.
fix_steps: Correct helper address to 10.10.40.5; renew lease and check server bindings.

symptom: All hosts on switch lose connectivity after unused ports were secured.
topology_note: Port security was enabled from a template.
show_outputs: show port-security interface Fa0/1: secure-shutdown. show interface Fa0/1: line protocol is down err-disabled.
expected_fault: Port security violation has err-disabled the uplink port.
fix_steps: Move port security off the uplink or adjust policy; recover interface and verify MAC limits.

symptom: Web server is reachable internally but not from outside via public IP.
topology_note: Static NAT should map 203.0.113.10 to 10.10.10.20.
show_outputs: show ip nat translations: no static entry for 203.0.113.10. show run: missing ip nat inside source static tcp statement.
expected_fault: Static NAT mapping for the web server is missing.
fix_steps: Add the static NAT mapping and permit HTTP/HTTPS in edge policy; verify from outside host.

symptom: Intermittent failures occur between two switches after a native VLAN change.
topology_note: Trunk between SW1 and SW2 carries user VLANs and native VLAN 999.
show_outputs: show interfaces trunk: SW1 native vlan 999; SW2 native vlan 1. CDP reports native VLAN mismatch.
expected_fault: Native VLAN mismatch exists on the trunk.
fix_steps: Set matching native VLAN on both trunk ends; clear counters and verify CDP warnings stop.
